profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at KLA
profile.summary: I am a dedicated and passionate software engineer with a decade of experience in app development for medical devices in both manufacturing and research & development. Broad range of experience in medical tech maintaining, updating and validating software releases to be compliant with federal and international standards on class III medical device software (FDA 21 CFR 820.70(i), ISO 13485).

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Work in developing C# .NET Desktop application used by doctors to program HF spinal cord stimulator (SCS). Follow development and V&V protocols for FDA and ISO medical device software.
positions.insights: Skills: Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM) · C# · Kotlin · Kotlin Multiplatform · .NET Framework · Verification and Validation (V&V) · Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) · Application Development · Visual Studio

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Work as a software engineer designing and maintaining C# .NET automation applications for the testing and tuning of cancer treatment machines using Agile and SCRUM processes. Design and perform V&V activities on all automation applications to ensure compliance with FDA and ISO standards for medical device software. Manage projects for NPI and business continuity to maintain, update and introduce new hardware/software to the manufacturing process. Perform NC-CAPA investigations on processes and software.
positions.insights: Skills: Azure DevOps Server · C# · Project Management · .NET Framework · Verification and Validation (V&V) · Application Development · Automation · Visual Studio
